latest.author: Wamphyre
latest.text: I'm glad to hear that you're now able to take advantage of the extra RAM and that most of your games are working perfectly! Regarding game compatibility issues, I'd recommend checking the official Ymir repository or opening an issue there so that the emulator's developer can investigate these specific problems: Thanks for testing and sharing your results!

latest.author: JapaGamesBr
latest.text: I just tested the following games after the latest emulator update: X-Men, Marvel Super Heroes, X-Men vs Street, Marvel vs Street, Real Bout Special, Samurai Shodown IV and Street Fighter Alpha 2. All of these games work perfectly using the external drive. Only two of the games I have didn't work: Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 and Gex. With Gex, the game starts normally, but it goes to a black screen during the first level. Mortal Kombat doesn't even start.
